recap.text:
Aiden Ng Has Big Day In Newport Select Gold 14U Loss To North Creek
November 8, 2026 vs. North Creek
Aiden Ng scored 15 points, but Newport Select Gold 14U still fell to North Creek, 46-29, on Sunday at Finn Hill Middle School.
Newport Select Gold 14U bested North Creek 13-6 in the third quarter, their strongest of the game.
Talen Tep and Ng each hit multiple three-pointers for Newport Select Gold 14U. The team shot 5-13 (38%) from beyond the arc. Kalden Sen pounded the glass, collecting five rebounds to lead Newport Select Gold 14U. Additional scorers for Newport Select Gold 14U included Sen (7 points), Tep (6 points), and Harry Zhang (1 point).
